card_title: Artist Notes: Cellular Renewal Face Mask
summary: Draw out impurities. A high-potency clay mask engineered to deeply decongest pores and accelerate cellular turnover.
description: Scientific detoxification. This intensive weekly treatment utilizes dual-action clays to absorb excess sebum while salicylic acid actively dissolves the protein bonds of dead skin cells.
technical_overview: Offered at $34.0 for 100ml, this KoColor FACE_MASK is expertly formulated with Kaolin, Bentonite, and Salicylic Acid. It delivers a high-fidelity Volcanic Ash color profile (`#708090`) and leverages osmotic drawing technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply an opaque layer to the T-zone and allow to semi-dry for 10 minutes before rinsing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Do not let the mask dry until it cracks, as this can disrupt the epidermal moisture barrier.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Formulated with a specific ratio of magnesium-rich bentonite to maximize toxin absorption without over-drying.
